text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Sprinters Stakes, King
Halo
looks at her image on a poster
displayed for all to
see and grins
proudly.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Unfazed by the reporters, she interacts
with her
fans as she makes her way to
the waiting room.
It's clear that her
popularity is sharply rising.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
"Here comes the racer we've all got our
eyes on,
the one who dominated earlier
this year in spring!
The quee—I mean,
King!" There's no mistaking
that she's
become the headliner of today's race to

decide the best sprinter.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Everyone's eyes are on Кинг Хало!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
